baseline.name: RUN_AGGREGATE_RESOURCE_VIEW
baseline.description: Only run-level tool_count/failure_count/session_peak/sum_tool_peaks/total_duration are retained; resource measurements are not bound to tool/effect identity.

intervention.name: TOOL_EFFECT_BOUND_PERFORMANCE_EVENTS
intervention.description: Represent each synthetic tool resource observation as an F2-shaped PERFORMANCE event carrying tool_use_id, effect_id, causal_id, generation and typed payload semantics.

fixture_scenarios: A: failed tool has 320 MB peak and successful tool 60 MB
B: failed tool has 60 MB peak and successful tool 320 MB

observed_result.causal_question: does the failed tool carry the run's highest observed tool peak?

conclusion.finding: Run aggregates can be identical while the causal association between failure and resource spike differs. Tool/effect-bound resource observations preserve that distinction.
conclusion.architecture_implication: F2-WP-605 can reuse the existing Evidence Spine PERFORMANCE channel and causal/tool/effect identities for a thin ResourceObservation payload contract; no second telemetry authority is necessary.
conclusion.limit: Synthetic identifiability evidence does not establish runtime overhead, collector accuracy, portability or whole-system benefit.

promotion_assessment.reason: E2 established a thin measurement-first design, three E3 falsifiers constrained unsafe donor semantics, and E4 showed unique causal-information value while fitting the existing F2 telemetry identity spine.

required_build_constraints: reuse existing F2 telemetry event authority rather than create a second truth store
PERFORMANCE resource observation must bind tool_use_id/effect_id/causal_id/generation where available
coverage and metric semantics must be explicit
exit 137 must not mint OOM truth without corroborating resource-event evidence
use typed serialization, not shell interpolation
agent resource hints are candidate input only and cannot self-grant budget/capability
fallback estimators must be typed DEGRADED/ESTIMATE rather than OBSERVED_CHILD_PEAK
next_exact_action: Acquire create-only R6-SEED-006/E5_BUILD_CANDIDATE if absent and emit one Trigger4 CONCEPT_DISTILL packet targeting F2-WP-605 with the exact E2/E3/E4 evidence and rejection tests.
